steps.title: Only bundle.js so far
steps.text: `src/index.js` does not import `print.js` at the top. Its click handler calls `import('./print.js')` instead, so webpack put `print.js` into a separate file, a chunk, which the browser downloads only when that call runs. Nothing has asked for it yet.
steps.textZh: `src/index.js` 没有在文件开头导入 `print.js`，而是在点击处理函数里调用 `import('./print.js')`。所以 webpack 把 `print.js` 放进了一个单独的文件，也就是 chunk（代码块），浏览器只在这次调用执行时才下载它。现在还没有谁请求过它。

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

steps.title: First click: the chunk arrives
steps.text: The click starts the download. The comment `webpackChunkName: "print"` named the file, and `output.chunkFilename: '[name].[contenthash].js'` added the hash. When the file arrives, its top-level `console.log` runs, then the click handler calls its default export: the console shows both lines.
steps.textZh: 点击开始下载。注释 `webpackChunkName: "print"` 给文件起了名字，`output.chunkFilename: '[name].[contenthash].js'` 加上了哈希。文件一到，它最外层的 `console.log` 先运行，接着点击处理函数调用它的默认导出：控制台里出现两行。
expectConsole: The print.js module has loaded! See the network tab in dev tools...

steps.title: Second click: nothing new to download
steps.titleZh: 第二次点击：不用再下载
steps.text: The module has already loaded, so `import()` gives back the same module without downloading anything. Only the second line appears: a module runs its top-level code once. The count below shows one request for the chunk after two clicks.
steps.textZh: 模块已经加载过了，所以 `import()` 直接交回同一个模块，不再下载任何东西。只出现第二行：模块最外层的代码只运行一次。下面的计数显示，点了两次，chunk 只请求过一次。
steps.actionLabelZh: 再点一次页面上的按钮

steps.title: See it in the Network panel
steps.text: Open the **Network** panel of the developer tools and reload the page: until the first click, the only script from this folder is `bundle.js`. The first load carries less code; in exchange, the first click waits for one more request. There is no loading indicator and no error handling: if the chunk fails to download, the click shows nothing.
steps.textZh: 打开开发者工具的 **Network**（网络）面板，再刷新页面：第一次点击之前，这个目录里被加载的脚本只有 `bundle.js`。首次加载的代码更少；代价是第一次点击要多等一个请求。这里没有加载提示，也没有错误处理：如果 chunk 下载失败，点击后什么也看不到。
